prompt: Origin: the team's own photo of its robot (a red 23511 alliance sign, a green roller intake) on Lovelace Field 2 at the 2026 FIRST World Championship in Houston, from the live seattlesolvers.com site (assets/robot-action-close.png), fetched 2026-09-27; levels stretched (0.5%) and gamma-lifted 1.12 so the dark arena holds up in the site duotone, webp q80. The robot is not named: the Worlds portfolio called the competing robot 'not yet final' on April 6, and a robot's sign color follows its alliance for each match, so the photo alone cannot tell Cypher from Enigma.
